reviews.t: My DIL likes them for the most part.
reviews.x: I bought this for my daughter in law for Christmas. I happened to ask her not long ago how they were working out. She said that then tend to chip quicker off her nails than what she's used to. Other than that. She loves the colors. Although I was disappointed to hear that. I gave it five stars because it was reasonably priced and she does like the colors. She just has to use many layers for it to stay on longer.

These are a great deal.  Shiny and beautiful. One coat of the kleancolor and a top coat of glitter polish stayed on my toes for weeks. One coat by itself chips of easy. Two coats is best or/and top with clear.  It's worth it for the colors. It is a bit thin so it dries fast which is great if you need to do nails real quick and get on with life with just one coat and deal with it later! I love this stuff!!!!

Was hopeful that his be a good nail polish with reading all the positive reviews.  However it stained my nails and made my nails very fragile.  Still am recovering from it now.  Had to cut off more then a 1/4 inch of my nails to get rid of the damage and i had to file the stain color off them which thinned the nails.  Nail polish remover would not get rid of the stain,  It had soaked into the nails and left an orange stain.  I had used the 3 fall color on my nails and would not recommend this to

reviews.t: Smells Weird, Broken brushes, Poor Quality
reviews.x: The colors in the bottle look very pretty and the items came quickly in the mail. I used the pink , purple and black polish, the brush was broken on one, bent on another and the other smelled horrible. Nail polish never smells great, but this was alarming how bad it smells. Like theyre old? The polishes seem discolored in the bottles too. I painted with the pink because it was the less bad smelling and even with 3 coats and a clear coat over it, they chipped the same day. These were cheap, but n

For how much all of them cost it isnt too bad. The colors are very pretty and i cant wait to use them all. They do have an overwhelming potent smell but luckily it completely goes away when it dries. My main complaint is that they chip pretty easily after a couple days but to be fair im a dog groomer so im constantly washing so im sure that contributes to it chipping sooner. All in all for a dollar each im pretty happy with my purchase.

reviews.t: Nice but a pain to remove
reviews.x: The colors are very nice but unfortunately one of the colors (purple) broke in shipping. It is now a thick mess and nearly unusable. The rest are fine and apply all shiny and nice. However it is also a pain to remove, so my tip is to soak a cottonball with nail polish remover, hold it onto the nail you want to remove the color with for a few seconds and then scrub. Takes a little more effort than most other nail polishes.

reviews.t: If you want great color, this is the set for you!!
reviews.x: Great array of colors! AMAZING pigment and quick drying! I am VERY pleased with this set!!  NOTE:  If you buy this set the only suggestion I have is to use a base coat before applying. With highly pigmented polish these tend to leave a residue on your nails when you remove the polish.
This was a great purchase. I love all the colors! Because they are metallic, it is a bit more work to get the polish off, but the colors are great nonetheless!
So great... I must stress use a base coat these colors stain acrylics with out a base. Can't wait for more colors
Did not get 12 colors as it says. Got 12 nail polishes. 2 of each color. Why would u need 2 of each color?

These. Colors. Are. Gorgeous. The yellow isn't quite as "yellow" as the picture, and the "red/maroon" is more orange/copper looking.....however, these colors are fantastic, and work really well with the metal stamping plates. Especially the black. White is rather sheer, but I wanted it that way, so that's fine with me, but keep that in mind if you're looking for an opaque white sparkle.

reviews.t: Love these, but I'm running out of the white :(
reviews.x: The metallic white has been my favorite and metallic pink and most of the blue hues--which is why I'm really ticked off  I use the metallic white A LOT more than the rest.  I'll have to buy more.  These won't chip with a good base and top coat (ALWAYS use a base and top coat), apply two coats of top coat, if needed, and always paint your free edge.

reviews.t: A great value for pretty polishes.
reviews.x: Nice bright colors!  The polish is pretty watery so it takes a few coats over either white or black so you get full color coverage, but really, at this price for this many bottles of polish.....are we really gonna whine?  I'm not!  I'm happy with them and double bonus they work great for stamping.

Colors are very pretty and it goes on very well. Not to thick and not to thin, and it dries fairly quickly which really helps! For the price I wasn't expecting much, but I was really surprised at good the quality was. A good buy!

reviews.t: Nail polish chips off the same day I painted them ...
reviews.x: Nail polish chips off the same day I painted them. Color will stain nails and differ cult to remove off nail.

reviews.t: Recommend wearing a base coat to prevent staining
reviews.x: Little junky, left my nails stained for a few days. Recommend wearing a base coat to prevent staining.
My daughter loved these. She had a spa/makeover bday party and they were perfect for it.

reviews.t: Some colors are hard to come off but worth it(:
reviews.x: Received my items before the set date (: The colors really pretty but I hard to come off
Great quality for $1/color!! It is easily applied using 1-2 coats.

My new favorite brand. Being a tomboy I never really treated myself to nail polish aside from the occasional clearance polish to doll up for an event...so I've sampled various brands. I found a great base and topcoat to use. So far none of the colors have stained my nails and while I work with boxes I don't mind the chipping too much so I get about a weeks worth of wear, maybe a little longer. Love how the colors pop and shine after one coat and goes one better than I hoped since they are cheap.

reviews.t: Best polishes I have ever used
reviews.x: I have been painting my 4yr daughter's nails for about a year now with polishes we get at CVS, Target, etc. I saw these on amazon for much cheaper, and thought it was at least worth a shot. First time using them, I was ready to throw out everything we had and only use these! The color pigmentation is amazing (except for the white) and they have full coverage in one coat (except for white and yellow which need 2.) reviews.t: I really like the metallic colors
reviews.x: The metallic colors in this set are truly beautiful. They are vibrant, and bright, with the exception of the white one, which is really more of an irritating barely opaque/barely transparent glitter. I would have liked more diversity in shades, but I really felt that the quality and quantity vs. cost of this product was definitely worth my purchase. The do chip quickly, even when using long-lasting clear coats with them, but that is something that I find to be true with nearly any standard nail

PERFECT JUST WHAT I WANTED!! Love Love the colors dries very quickly!  Excuse the messy paint job on the pic. I just got the polish in and put it on just to see what i got.  These are 8 colors out of 12 there is also 2 beautiful blues a black and purple not shown. All the colors are beautiful bright and shiny.. For $12.84 free shipping with prime it comes to $1.07 per bottle great price!!  Would def. order again. Thank you!!

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the bright, gorgeous colors and consider the set a great value for the price.
Many reviewers note the polish chips easily and recommend using a base and top coat or multiple coats.
Several reviewers mention staining nails or acrylics and advise using a base coat.
Some reviewers complain about a strong or weird smell.
A few reviewers report problems like broken brushes, broken bottles in shipping, or receiving duplicate colors instead of 12 distinct ones.
